method: Agent opened all 31 master pages at readable 110 dpi using the image viewer. Page 7 was rebuilt with an additional 3 mm section gap and opened again. The integration verifier checks that all other final renders are unchanged and that every extracted page is pixel-identical to its master page.
findings: Readable cover, one-page guide, assembly, full rules and blank human record.
Page 7's final section was visually too close to the Passage paragraph. Added 3 mm without changing text, page count, component IDs or rules; inspected the final page again.
Five whole mats retain readable counters, four ordinary seats, separate PoLong spaces and concealed-route staging.
All cut-sheet labels, artwork identities, memory effects, anger tracks, cut borders and small marker labels are visible without clipping.
No remaining visible text collision, missing glyph, clipped effect or cut-border defect in the final render.
limitations: Not an actual printer, cutting or handling check
Not a human playtest or team art approval
